title: On the Origin of Taxa
content: A minimally monophyletic group is one ancestral species with four immediate descendant species. This number is optimized by the Pareto ratio as a pattern constant, which is expressed as an inverse power law at ln5/ln4 or fractal dimension 1.161. Taxa are generated by symmetry breaking of the immediate ancestron (the set of new traits of the single ancestral species shared by all immediate descendant species). Analysis used established caulistic techniques associated with descent with modification modeling, namely Shannon information with Turing sequential Bayes. The data is from taxonomic analyses using numerically enhanced classical methods of evolutionary taxonomy. Fractal modeling was done with the mathematical aid of an Artificial Intelligence leading to a quadratic model, which, because of self-similarity, is applicable to all taxonomic ranks.
